global_reading_rule: Every lane is a complete map of the required implications. A conditional or owed arrow is not a completed source derivation. No individual protected defect is assigned to a Standard Model species.

status_legend.finite_proved: Exact result on the specified finite construction.
status_legend.conditional_field: Additional field, state, locality or Lorentz assumptions are supplied.
status_legend.conditional_SM: Exact consequence of the supplied Standard Model effective action; not a source-selected parameter.
status_legend.conditional_calibrated: An explicit source action is realized with declared calibration inputs.
status_legend.conditional_extension: A specified extension supplies data absent from the minimal matter module.
status_legend.physical_match_owed: The physical source/state/clock or detector-matching implication is unproved.

shared_assumptions: Weak SU(2) indices and physical Lorentz spin are different structures.
Fermionic CAR is proved on the configured field architecture; physical spin-statistics additionally needs the stated local Lorentzian physical completion.
Conjugate internal charges do not alone prove equal measured particle/antiparticle masses; the benchmark uses the stated CPT/vacuum hypotheses.
All quoted GeV values and their uncertainties/schemes are read from the frozen reference table, not recomputed source predictions.
Neutrino flavor channels have no individual mass eigenvalue; the three mass fields and their mixing are separate.
Photons require specified detection measurements; quarks/gluons and unstable fields require their appropriate inclusive or resonance observables.
A graviton and composite hadrons lie outside this elementary Standard Model census.

lanes.title: Charged leptons: electron, muon, tau

stages.title: The same charge, three configured family slots
stages.text: The internal lepton doublet and conjugate singlet carry the right charge weights. Their currents act on complete fermionic occupation states. Three family copies are supplied; they are not three defect types.

stages.title: Attach a propagating spinor
stages.text: Left and right charged components pair through a Higgs interaction. Anticommuting creation operators give finite fermionic statistics. Physical spin one-half uses the supplied Lorentz spinor action.

links.label: Native Weyl action and eight valleys
Finite quantum Higgs with the same Gauss law

stages.title: Diagonalize the complete response
stages.text: A coherent three-cycle gives Y=C²/3 and exact Koide balance in its positive chamber. A retained loss flag changes the amplitude. One-ratio and all-three-mass calibrations are distinct constructions.

stages.title: Record a charged threshold or decay resonance
stages.text: Electron energy needs a charged infrared threshold or inclusive dressing prescription. Muon and tau masses and lifetimes come from unstable resonance and decay records. A free action frequency supplies neither their widths nor their detector identity.
stages.formula: e: threshold; μ, τ: mass + width

lanes.missing_bridge: Derive the family controller and its interactions from the same source, state and clock; compute kinetic/self-energy matching and an actual defect creation map.

lanes.title: Up-type quarks: up, charm, top

stages.title: Color triplets in the internal dictionary
stages.text: The upper weak-doublet component and conjugate up singlet have the correct internal current weights. The source dictionary fixes these weights before target names are assigned.

stages.title: Supply chiral colored spinors
stages.text: The full fermionic field carries the same color and weak currents. The conditional SM action supplies Lorentz spinors and a complex family Yukawa matrix. The eight lattice valleys need a gauge-compatible chiral treatment.
stages.formula: Q_L H uᶜ is gauge invariant

links.label: Native Weyl action and eight valleys

stages.title: Up-sector eigenvalues and flavor mixing
stages.text: The singular values of the canonically normalized up matrix define quadratic masses. Its left family rotation combines with the down rotation to give CKM mixing. These matrices are inputs in the conditional benchmark.

links.label: Yukawa singular values and kinetic normalization

stages.title: Infer parameters from hadrons, jets and top decays
stages.text: Color confinement prevents an isolated free-quark detector pole. Up and charm reference masses use stated running schemes. The displayed top value is an event-kinematic extraction, distinct from a pole-mass convention.
stages.formula: m_q(μ) needs a scheme; top needs a reconstruction convention

lanes.missing_bridge: Derive complex up/down family kernels and the interacting color sector. The rejected light-quark texture cannot be repaired by one energy rescaling.

lanes.title: Down-type quarks: down, strange, bottom

stages.title: The other component of the same weak doublet
stages.text: The lower weak-doublet component has electric charge −1/3. Its conjugate singlet carries +1/3. The same finite color-current action distinguishes triplet and conjugate triplet.

stages.title: Couple the down spinor to the conjugate Higgs
stages.text: The gauge-invariant down Yukawa channel preserves color and couples the charged components through the selected Higgs phase. Physical spin and chiral propagation use the stated field assumptions.
stages.formula: Q_L H† dᶜ is gauge invariant

links.label: Native Weyl action and eight valleys

stages.title: One family matrix, three singular values
stages.text: A complex Y_d and its kinetic normalization determine the down-sector action spectrum. The benchmark supplies them independently; an internal charge count does not set their magnitudes.

stages.title: Use color-singlet and jet observables
stages.text: Down and strange values are running parameters at 2 GeV. Bottom is quoted at its own running-mass scale. Their uncertainty conventions must accompany a comparison; none is the mass of a freely detected quark.
stages.formula: d,s: MSbar at 2 GeV; b: MSbar at μ=m_b(μ)

lanes.missing_bridge: Compute the same-source chiral gauge theory, its complex Yukawas and QCD matching. Supply measured-observable predictions rather than renaming source coefficients.

lanes.title: Neutrinos: flavor records and mass eigenfields

stages.title: A neutral component, no sterile singlet
stages.text: The upper component of L has Q=0. The fifteen-state module contains no right-handed neutrino singlet. Three configured copies give three neutral components without deriving neutrino masses.

stages.title: Choose an explicit neutrino extension
stages.text: Dirac masses require three added neutral singlets. A Weinberg operator instead supplies Majorana masses within the low-energy field census. These are different physical completions.

links.label: Neutrino extension and its field count

stages.title: Mass fields mix into flavor amplitudes
stages.text: Diagonalization gives ν1, ν2 and ν3. Their mass values are not individually assigned to the νe, νμ and ντ labels. Propagation phases depend on the mass eigenvalues and travel time.

stages.title: Prepare one flavor and detect another
stages.text: Production and detection tag flavor through charged-current partners. Oscillations constrain mass-squared differences and mixing. Absolute masses and Dirac/Majorana character remain undetermined input data in this atlas.
stages.formula: Oscillations: Δm² and mixing; no mass for a flavor label

lanes.missing_bridge: Select the neutral interaction and family mixing from source records, then derive oscillation probabilities with the same propagation and detector clock.

lanes.title: Photon: the unbroken electromagnetic channel

targets.antiparticle: Self-conjugate in the conditional field theory

stages.title: One unbroken current combination
stages.text: The internal relation Q=T3+Y annihilates a supplied neutral Higgs direction. This identifies a current combination. A separate finite construction has a two-dimensional transverse oscillator fiber.

links.label: Unbroken direction from the gauge Hessian

stages.title: Attach a transverse gauge field
stages.text: The benchmark supplies a local gauge action and its quantization. The vector A combines W3 and B along the neutral null direction. Gauge constraints leave two physical helicities.

stages.title: No rest-energy term in the unbroken phase
stages.text: The neutral gauge Hessian has an exact zero eigenvalue under its stated Higgs and gauge assumptions. A wavepacket nevertheless carries energy and momentum. The massless field is not an energy-free record.

stages.title: Detect a photon through its interaction
stages.text: Localized absorption records implement a detector measurement. Polarization, arrival position and energy distributions require a specified state and detector. A universal sharp particle-position operator is not assumed.
stages.formula: Position: detector POVM; momentum/energy: detector response

lanes.missing_bridge: Derive Maxwell dynamics, the physical gauge quotient, selected state/clock and detector coupling on the same source; prove the transverse candidate is the measured photon.

lanes.title: Gluons: eight directions of an interacting color field

targets.antiparticle: Real adjoint multiplet; eight color directions

stages.title: Eight exact color-current directions
stages.text: The admitted current algebra supplies non-Abelian color brackets and their action on matter. Counting eight directions alone would not identify a Lie algebra; the commutators are part of the finite result.

stages.title: Supply a dynamical color gauge connection
stages.text: A Yang–Mills connection transports color and interacts with colored matter. The finite quantum-link construction preserves Gauss identities, while its continuum gauge dynamics and physical state require an additional construction.
stages.formula: Gᵃμν includes g_s fᵃᵇᶜ Aᵇμ Aᶜν

stages.title: Unbroken gauge coefficients, interacting infrared physics
stages.text: The supplied color-preserving phase gives zero gluon mass parameters. Confinement and color-singlet mass scales concern interacting spectra; a zero gauge coefficient does not imply eight observable free zero-mass particles.

stages.title: Infer color dynamics from jets and hadrons
stages.text: Scattering and hadronization produce color-singlet records. A gluon contribution is reconstructed through these observables; no free isolated gluon rest-mass measurement is assigned.
stages.formula: Measure jet, hadron and inclusive scattering distributions

lanes.missing_bridge: Derive the source gauge kinetic coefficient and running coupling, an interacting physical state, confinement-sensitive observables and controlled detector matching.

lanes.title: Charged weak bosons: W+ and W−

stages.title: Weak raising and lowering currents
stages.text: The weak-current algebra contains T+ and T− with opposite electric charges. These operator weights are exact; a propagating vector field is an additional attachment.

stages.title: Mix vector fields with Higgs directions
stages.text: The supplied Higgs phase gives W±=(W1∓iW2)/√2. Two Goldstone directions become their longitudinal polarizations. The benchmark vectors have spin one and three massive polarizations each.

stages.title: The charged gauge direction costs rest energy
stages.text: The quadratic Higgs kinetic term gives equal W masses for the chosen coupling and vacuum scale. Physical particle/antiparticle equality uses the local Lorentz/CPT hypotheses, not electric-charge conjugacy alone.

stages.title: Reconstruct an unstable charged resonance
stages.text: W bosons decay before an asymptotic stable-particle measurement. Their mass and width come from decay and scattering distributions with a stated line-shape convention. The reference average excludes CDF2022.
stages.formula: Detector records → resonance mass and width

lanes.missing_bridge: Select the Higgs phase, normalize g and v in the common source clock, compute self-energy and decay vertices, and match complete detector distributions.

lanes.title: Z boson: the orthogonal neutral gauge direction

targets.antiparticle: Self-conjugate in the conditional field theory

stages.title: A second direction in the neutral-current plane
stages.text: The same T3 and Y currents define a two-dimensional neutral plane. Internal algebra alone leaves the physical mixing angle and the relative kinetic normalization unspecified.

links.label: Current kinetic forms and free coefficients

stages.title: Separate the photon and massive neutral vector
stages.text: With supplied canonical gauge kinetics and Higgs phase, the Z direction is orthogonal to the photon in the vector mass matrix. One Goldstone direction supplies its longitudinal mode.

stages.title: Both weak and hypercharge couplings contribute
stages.text: The nonzero neutral Hessian eigenvalue fixes the quadratic Z mass once g, g′ and v are supplied. This is an exact conditional formula, not a source selection of those parameters.

stages.title: Fit the neutral resonance line shape
stages.text: The displayed Z reference uses a Breit–Wigner convention. A pole definition is a different matched quantity. Its branching fractions and width require the interacting detector response.

lanes.missing_bridge: Compute source gauge normalization, electroweak mixing, the selected phase and the full neutral self-energy before identifying the measured resonance.

lanes.title: Higgs: the radial fluctuation of the selected scalar phase

targets.antiparticle: Self-conjugate radial scalar in the conditional field theory

stages.title: An allowed charged scalar coupling
stages.text: The matter grammar admits a weak doublet with hypercharge +1/2. A finite quantum-scalar vertex preserves the same Gauss law. Its three-state carrier is not a selected continuum Higgs vacuum.

stages.title: Supply a scalar field and a broken phase
stages.text: The effective action has a positive quartic and a chosen broken-phase vacuum. A gauge-fixed neutral direction describes this phase; it is not a gauge-invariant expectation of a charged local operator.

stages.title: Curvature sets the radial oscillation frequency
stages.text: Three angular directions join the massive gauge fields. One radial mode is left, with spin zero. Its quadratic rest-energy scale is set by the curvature of the normalized scalar potential.

stages.title: Reconstruct the scalar from its decay products
stages.text: The Higgs mass is a resonance observable. Decay channels, production rates and widths depend on its interacting couplings and matching; the finite scalar carrier alone supplies none of these laboratory values.
stages.formula: Production and decay records → scalar resonance

lanes.missing_bridge: Derive the phase and scalar effective potential from common-source correlations, normalize its kinetic term and compute physical production/decay response.

calibration_paths.title: One-ratio phase calibration
calibration_paths.input: Measured muon/electron ratio chooses the balanced coherent phase; electron mass may set one energy unit.
calibration_paths.what_it_buys: A charged action with a held-out tau comparison. Exact Koide balance is retained.
calibration_paths.removal_strategy: Derive the coherent relative phase from the source Hamiltonian or selected state, then evaluate all three charged ratios without reading a mass target.
calibration_paths.success_condition: One source-selected phase and common kinetic normalization; held-out masses remain within stated observable-matching errors.

calibration_paths.title: Three-input attenuator calibration
calibration_paths.input: Electron, muon and tau central masses choose attenuation, phase and one common energy factor.
calibration_paths.what_it_buys: The complete sixteen-outcome controller realizes the chosen charged triplet. Zero held-out mass predictions.
calibration_paths.removal_strategy: Calculate the retained loss process and coherent family kernel from the same native dynamics; derive the energy conversion from an independent clock rather than these three masses.
calibration_paths.success_condition: The computed r, phase and common normalization agree with the physical matching calculation before target masses are read.

calibration_paths.title: Capacity law and closure choices
calibration_paths.input: The P-law phase baseline, attenuation function, normalization, source coordinates and running-field census are stipulated; one endpoint inherits measured alpha.
calibration_paths.what_it_buys: Four certified conditional action spectra and complete C-duty inverse realizations.
calibration_paths.removal_strategy: Derive the actual memory/controller response and its capacity dependence, including the running census, from source records. Use self-consistency after that law is fixed.
calibration_paths.success_condition: No target-selected architecture or measured endpoint enters the prediction; the derived response is stable under the stated capacity/refinement limit.

links.label: Capacity does not select the response law

calibration_paths.title: A common clock and energy unit
calibration_paths.input: Weak-kick time, preparation/reference choice and conversion to GeV are supplied.
calibration_paths.what_it_buys: Comparable source frequencies and optional laboratory-unit tables.
calibration_paths.removal_strategy: Tie the time-translation generator and detector timestamps to one operational clock, retain compilation overhead, and derive a reference energy relation independent of the fitted particle.
calibration_paths.success_condition: Every sector and detector uses the same clock, with bounded conversion and finite-capacity errors.

calibration_paths.title: Three families and a chiral regulator
calibration_paths.input: Three copies of the fifteen-component module and a naive Weyl kinetic action are configured.
calibration_paths.what_it_buys: The finite internal representation and controlled free branches, including all eight valleys.
calibration_paths.removal_strategy: Derive family multiplicity and construct a gauge-covariant chiral low-energy sector with canonical CAR, controlled mirror removal and a suitable physical state.
calibration_paths.success_condition: Exactly the intended light representations propagate; anomaly and Ward identities survive the same controlled limit.

calibration_paths.title: Gauge couplings and Higgs phase
calibration_paths.input: Renormalized g_s, g, g′, scalar potential and the broken-phase scale are supplied.
calibration_paths.what_it_buys: Conditional photon/gluon zeros and W, Z and Higgs mass formulas.
calibration_paths.removal_strategy: Extract gauge and scalar two-point kernels plus higher vertices from the selected common-source state; demonstrate the phase and its kinetic normalization.
calibration_paths.success_condition: Couplings, symmetry breaking and scalar curvature follow from those correlators with scale/scheme and error control, without measured mass substitutions.

calibration_paths.title: Quark Yukawas, mixing and CP phases
calibration_paths.input: Independent complex up/down family matrices and renormalized flavor parameters are supplied.
calibration_paths.what_it_buys: A conditional quark census and the algebraic CKM construction.
calibration_paths.removal_strategy: Compute complex family-changing kernels and their covariant kinetic forms from the source; propagate the result through QCD and electroweak matching.
calibration_paths.success_condition: Mass ratios, mixing and CP-sensitive observables share one independently derived action. A common multiplier cannot rescue an excluded light-quark shape.

calibration_paths.title: Neutrino mechanism and mixing
calibration_paths.input: Dirac singlets or a Majorana Weinberg operator, its family coefficient and mixing are additional choices.
calibration_paths.what_it_buys: A complete conditional neutral sector with symbolic mass eigenvalues.
calibration_paths.removal_strategy: Identify and implement the allowed source neutral interaction and flavor-current intertwiner, then derive its propagator and detector oscillation records.
calibration_paths.success_condition: Nonzero observed mass-squared differences and flavor probabilities arise in the same clock, with a declared absolute-scale and Dirac/Majorana prediction or unresolved parameter.

calibration_paths.title: From an action coefficient to a measured mass
calibration_paths.input: Physical kinetic matrices, self-energy, infrared dressing and resonance conventions require additional matching.
calibration_paths.what_it_buys: Necessary correction budgets and exact conditional whitening bounds, without a calculated interaction correction.
calibration_paths.removal_strategy: Measure complete connected correlators in one selected interacting state, extract their temporal/spatial kernels and self-energy, and propagate actual errors to the named detector observable.
calibration_paths.success_condition: A charged threshold, resonance or running parameter is obtained in its stated scheme with a controlled uncertainty; no adjustable matrix is chosen solely to improve agreement.

calibration_paths.title: From a protected label to a species
calibration_paths.input: A source current or protected winding does not by itself identify a natural particle.
calibration_paths.what_it_buys: Finite charge records, compact localized modes and supplied field attachments.
calibration_paths.removal_strategy: Construct creation, transport, fusion and decay operators for the defect in the same state and Gauss sector. Compare their charge transformations, spectral weight and scattering records with the candidate field.
calibration_paths.success_condition: One operational intertwiner preserves charge, dynamics, statistics and complete measurements; fixed-texture bound frequencies are not relabeled as relativistic rest masses.

mass_explainer.title: A rest-energy scale, once the clock and dynamics are fixed
mass_explainer.text: A massive field branch has an energy cost even at zero momentum, measured above its chosen vacuum. In the supplied Higgs action that rest-energy scale comes from the normalized coupling to the chosen phase. Calling repair effort energy requires an independent source-to-clock and generator calibration. A static defect can also carry background and binding energy, so its trapped-mode frequency is not automatically a particle rest mass.

gauge_theorems.title: Why the gauge algebra has the Standard Model type
gauge_theorems.premises: A faithful complete reversible twelve-port response closes under commutators in u(H). Proper carrier rotations act by inner automorphisms on that same response. The compact-Lie classification and fixed-space hypotheses apply.
gauge_theorems.result: The transitive A5 action has one fixed line. The centre has dimension one; the centreless su(2)^4 alternative is excluded. The remaining compact semisimple part is su(2)⊕su(3). Hence g≅u(1)⊕su(2)⊕su(3).
gauge_theorems.formula: 12 = 1 + 3 + 8, with compactness, brackets and the inner-action exclusion
gauge_theorems.boundary: Twelve ports alone do not imply this algebra. Lean proves finite dimension/fixed-space arithmetic under explicit centre/classification adapters; the paper supplies the Lie argument. Executable current selection and physical gauge-field attachment are separate.

links.label: Gauge paper Theorem3.1: fixed-space Lie-type proof

gauge_theorems.title: Which charges and interaction channels fit that algebra
gauge_theorems.premises: The declared current matrix, spin lift and finite exterior-sector menu are supplied. Anomaly cancellation selects a conjugate projector pair within that menu; tensor descent is checked on the realized matter tensors.
gauge_theorems.result: The fifteen weights form Q,uᶜ,dᶜ,L,eᶜ, with the Standard Model hypercharges. A Higgs doublet admits up, down and charged-lepton Yukawa channels. The maximal faithful local matter image has diagonal Z6 kernel.
gauge_theorems.boundary: The local tensor data admit the cover and its Z2,Z3,Z6 quotients. They do not select the physical global gauge group, three generations, fermion statistics or any Yukawa magnitude. The spin/exterior attachments are explicit premises.

links.label: Gauge paper Proposition6.2 and hypercharge theorem

gauge_theorems.title: The same currents admit actual finite interactions
gauge_theorems.premises: Use the configured full fermionic occupation space, the native finite quantum links, a quantum-scalar carrier and declared hopping/Yukawa coefficients. The gauge action includes every original sector.
gauge_theorems.result: Local Gauss generators have the same Lie brackets, and their commutators with the finite hopping and quantum-Higgs Hamiltonian vanish. Complete record feedback realizes its specified mean interaction without discarding failures or dividing by duty probability.
gauge_theorems.boundary: This proves a finite interacting gauge system. It selects no numerical gauge/Yukawa coupling, physical Higgs phase, common laboratory clock or interacting chiral continuum. A finite invariant vertex is stronger than a count of field labels.

family_cost_selector.title: A finite shortcut toward the family count
family_cost_selector.premises: Restrict to faithful carrier bands in the declared dimension window[3,5]; identify the physical multiplicity object with such a band and compare it by the operational seam-cost order.
family_cost_selector.result: The exact spectral table selects the rank-three band as the unique cost minimum among those candidates.
family_cost_selector.boundary: The multiplicity-object and operational-cost identifications are extra premises. The unrestricted table selects the trivial band. The result neither makes the spatial rank-three band automatically three generations nor removes the eight kinetic valleys.
